# telnyx_email_domain (Data Source)

A domain for sending email and, optionally, receiving it. The DNS records to publish are in `dns_records` and in the `telnyx_email_domain_dns_records` data source; verify them with the `telnyx_email_domain_verify` action.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `dkim` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim))
- `dmarc_policy` (Attributes) Customer DMARC policy. null means use the advisory default (v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@telnyx.com). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dmarc_policy))
- `dns_records` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_records))
- `domain` (String) The domain name, such as `mail.example.com`.
- `inbound` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inbound))
- `inbound_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the domain receives email for its inboxes.
- `record_type` (String)
- `reputation` (Attributes) Sender reputation for this domain (present on all domain responses). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reputation))
- `status` (String)
- `tracking` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tracking))
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `usable_for_inbound` (Boolean)
- `usable_for_sending` (Boolean)
- `verification` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verification))
- `verified_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--dkim"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dkim`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean)
- `algorithm` (String)
- `key_length` (Number)
- `rotated_at` (String)
- `selector` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--dmarc_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dmarc_policy`

Read-Only:

- `p` (String) Policy applied to messages that fail alignment. One of `none`, `quarantine`, `reject`.
- `pct` (Number) Percentage of messages the policy applies to. Omitted from the record when 100.
- `rua` (String) URI for aggregate reports. Defaults to the Telnyx address when absent; null omits it.
- `sp` (String) Policy for subdomains. Omitted from the record when null. One of `none`, `quarantine`, `reject`.

<a id="nestedatt--reputation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reputation`

Read-Only:

- `band` (String) Reputation band, e.g. good/warn/poor.
- `breakdown` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `computed_at` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--tracking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tracking`

Read-Only:

- `click_tracking` (Boolean) Rewrite HTML links through a tracking redirect to record click events.
- `open_tracking` (Boolean) Inject a tracking pixel into HTML messages to record open events.
- `unsubscribe_tracking` (Boolean) Add RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers with a signed one-click unsubscribe URL. Enabled by default; Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender rules require one-click unsubscribe support.
